## Welcome!

We are so excited that you are interested in contributing to `heritable`. In these contributing guidelines you'll find infomation on: 

- Quickstart for contributors
- Types of contributions 
- Development workflow 
- Code style
- Documentation and tests
- Dependencies + compatibility
- Code of Conduct

### Quickstart for contributors

### Types of contributions

- Bugs, documentation, tests, performance improvements, small features, datasets. 

Take a look at the Github Issues for outstanding bugs and features. 

#### What we are not looking for are
What you don’t want via PR (e.g., big new features without prior discussion).

Where to propose ideas (GitHub Issues/Discussions) and what info to include.

### Development workflow 

Branch and PR, test must all pass before the feature is merged in 

Branch by feature so its digestible to review

### Code style

Pipeable, modularised functions, tidyverse

### Documentation and tests

Every function including internal helpers need docs using roxygen2. 

Consider test-driven development 

Fixtures of asreml model objects

### Dependencies 

asreml is properiarty

### Code of Conduct

We value open and respectful communication in successful collaborations. 

We are humans before we are statisticians, before we are programmers, so communicate with each other kindly.
